title: Stable influence upper bound
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $f:\\{-1,1\\}^n\\to\\{-1,1\\}$ be a Boolean function. If $\\delta\\ge 0$, $0\\le\\rho\\le 1$, and $2/(1+\\rho)=1+\\delta$, then the total stable influence of the real-valued sign representation of $f$ at parameter $\\rho$ is at most $\\operatorname{Inf}_{\\max}(f)^\\delta\\,\\operatorname{Inf}_{\\mathrm{tot}}(f)$, where $\\operatorname{Inf}_{\\max}$ is the maximum coordinate influence and $\\operatorname{Inf}_{\\mathrm{tot}}$ is the total influence of that sign representation.
